responsibility: Implements the Arm/AArch64 backend RTL pass that inserts Branch Target Identification instructions when branch protection requests BTI. The pass walks final RTL basic blocks and labels, adds BTI J protection to indirect-jump targets such as preserved labels, nonlocal-goto targets, jump-table entries, and setjmp return points, and adds BTI C at function entry for indirectly callable functions that are not already protected by PAC prologue instructions. It also provides the pass gate and factory hook used by the Arm pass pipeline.
